label: GitLab.com (public projects, no token)
terms_note: Public, unauthenticated reads of GitLab.com. GitLab publishes a partial OpenAPI 2.0 description (doc/api/openapi/openapi_v2.yaml, 2.4 MB YAML); it lists id_after and order_by for GET /api/v4/projects but not the `pagination=keyset` parameter the HTML docs describe, so keyset paging comes from the docs. Keyset pages are linked only through the Link response header (rel="next" carrying id_after); unauthenticated requests are limited (RateLimit-Limit: 500 per minute observed 2026-10-01).

list_items.note: Public projects (oldest id first) whose name or path matches query; collection is ignored (projects only). Pages by cursor: pass next_cursor back.

get_item.note: item_id is the numeric project id (list_items), or the URL-encoded path 'group%2Fproject' (GitLab rejects a raw slash).

not_offered.me: No token in this public entry.
not_offered.create_item: Needs a token; public read entry only.
not_offered.update_item: Needs a token; public read entry only.
not_offered.delete_item: Needs a token; public read entry only.
